items.statement: The two explicitly defined electronic states are compared only after object-specific stationarity validation.
items.expected: Singlet charge −1/multiplicity 1 and triplet charge −1/multiplicity 3 are each traceable and validated with no imaginary modes, or a failed endpoint is honestly reported.

items.statement: The validated state Gibbs-energy comparison reaches the source-supported gap.
items.expected: ΔG(triplet−singlet) is 23.5 kcal/mol within ordinary computational reproducibility variation.

items.statement: The excited-state density analysis resolves spatial donor and acceptor character.
items.expected: The analysis supports a hole/donor region on the oxindole-enolate portion and an electron/acceptor region on the cinnamonitrile portion, or clearly reports unresolved character with evidence.
